BCSO

Blaine County Sheriff’s Office

Honor. Integrity. Service. From the highways to the skies, we protect and serve Blaine County.

Our Units

Specialized teams, one department.

Speed Unit

Built to Catch Up

Our Speed Unit puts high-performance pursuit vehicles on the road to stop fleeing suspects and keep Blaine County’s highways safe.

Canine Unit

Handler and Partner

K-9 teams track, search, and protect alongside their deputies, a bond that makes the whole department stronger.

Air Support

Eyes in the Sky

From the helipad, Air Support gives ground units a view they can’t get any other way during searches and pursuits.

Patrol

Every Road, Every Hour

Day or night, from desert highways to the city skyline, patrol deputies are the face of the Sheriff’s Office.
